title: Leandro meets Thierry Jamin and the Inca Institute takes up research
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Leandro meets Thierry Jamin and the Inca Institute takes up research, about 2016-present at Nazca region, Peru, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In 2016, he met a French explorer of ancient Incan lost cities named Thierry Jamin.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how a man named Leandro, connected to strange three-fingered bodies said to come from the Nazca region of Peru, met a French explorer of lost Inca cities named Thierry Jamin in 2016. According to Michels, from then on Jamin's research group, the Inca Institute, took up studying the finds, which matters because if the bodies are real they would not be human.
